source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Configuration" -> Click "SNMP"
Check SNMP information when it is enabled.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: SNMP v1/v3 function should be normal and information should be displayed correctly.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: net-snmp + a 2nd host; BMC SNMP agent configured by operator
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP v1/v3 verifies the BMC SNMP agent/trap functionality; it needs a management/trap-receiver host and enabling/configuring SNMP on the BMC Web UI (community/v3 + trap destination). Agent can from the trap receiver run `snmpget -v3 ... "$BMC_IP" system.sysDescr.0 2>&1` to sanity-check the agent after it is configured by the operator.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpget/walk output confirming the BMC SNMP agent responds for the SNMP v1/v3 mode; the trap destination/receiver setup + Web UI enable is the operator part.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: enabling SNMP + pointing traps is a config change on the BMC; needs a 2nd host as trap receiver and read-only community.

original_test_intent: Validate supported SNMP v1 and v3 management behavior and displayed BMC configuration.
original_method: Engineer inspects/enables SNMP WebUI; source does not identify whether both modes, queries, traps, OIDs or values are required.
manual_activity: Engineer configures and observes WebUI; protocol transactions and comparisons can then be automated.
safety_requirements: Do not expose community or SNMPv3 secrets.
Use least-privilege read-only views and approved network endpoints.
Do not infer v1 behavior from v3 or query behavior from traps.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, run each approved protocol transaction, capture full redacted responses and compare expected values.
Do not claim WebUI observation or verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: An abbreviated v3 GET cannot cover unspecified v1 or trap behavior and is not executable as written.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Define separate v1 and v3 test vectors with explicit OIDs/values and security profiles.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: WebUI procedure, v1/v3 criterion and 5/0-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Split modes into explicit read and, if required, trap vectors; record accepted/rejected security behavior and restore baseline.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, MIB and Net-SNMP versions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents one successful v3 GET from satisfying v1/v3 functionality.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SNMPv1 may be prohibited by project security policy.

project_override_considerations: A security-approved v3-only project plan is valid for that project but cannot be reported as v1 coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The slash-separated v1/v3 criterion is ambiguous, Procedure only displays UI information, and DeepSeek asserts agent/trap coverage from an incomplete v3 GET.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended protocol-function matrix and values are required project inputs. Both read transactions can be automated after an engineer configures the modes; missing inputs do not create a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects partial v3 query as cross-mode proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects BLOCKED to PACKAGE: the matrix is a required input and WebUI configuration is manual setup before an automatable core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps capability, readiness and verdict separate.

review_improvement: Requires per-mode, per-function acceptance and secret handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: SNMPv1 and v3 need different security/configuration, but an approved matrix makes the transactions automatable. The attended WebUI configuration makes this PARTIAL rather than BLOCKED.
